description: This file contains unit tests for network information iterators and adapters, using Google Test framework, focused on IPv4, IPv6, and adapter iteration functionalities within the core module.

classes.name: AdapterIterator
classes.description: Iterator for network adapters, supporting iteration over adapter properties and addresses.

classes.name: IPV4AddressIterator
classes.description: Iterator for IPv4 addresses associated with network adapters.

classes.name: IPV6AddressIterator
classes.description: Iterator for IPv6 addresses associated with network adapters.

classes.name: AdapterObserver
classes.description: Observer class for network adapter status notifications.

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next element.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the current iterator state is valid.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the adapter.

methods.name: UP
methods.description: Checks or sets whether the adapter is up.

methods.name: Count
methods.description: Returns the number of addresses or items.

methods.name: MACAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the MAC address of the adapter.

methods.name: HostName
methods.description: Gets the hostname associated with an IP address.

methods.name: IsMulticast
methods.description: Determines if an IP address is multicast.

methods.name: IsLocalInterface
methods.description: Determines if an IP address is local to the interface.
